text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 2) 2015.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh dari 22 Mei 2015 hingga 2 Jun 2015.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kerbau import (India)

2. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

3. Babi hidup

4. Daging babi (perut)

5. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 21 Mei 2015

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VIII]

DATO' SRI HASAN BIN MALEK

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri,

Koperasi dan Kepenggunaan

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 2) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 2) Order 2015.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for

the period from 22 May 2015 to 2 June 2015.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Imported buffalo meat (India)

2. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including Beijing

cabbage)

3. Live pig

4. Pork (belly)

5. Pork (lean and fat)

Made 21 May 2015

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VIII]

DATO' SRI HASAN BIN MALEK

Minister of Domestic Trade,

Co-operatives and Consumerism
